name: app-pastel-health-dashboard-phone-with-isolated-metric-cards
title: Pastel Health Dashboard with Metric Cards
whatItIs: Three white rounded panels on light grey: a phone with a greeting, a blue blood sugar card, and pastel purple, green and peach cards for steps, sleep and calories; and two panels isolating those cards at large scale.
whatItMeans: Each metric gets its own pastel, so the dashboard reads at a glance, and enlarged cards show the design details.
techniques: Isolated component crops beside the full screen
Red and dark bars for the blood-sugar spark chart
Dark pill navigation with a blue plus button

vocabulary.definition: A card showing one measure and its trend.
A small unit label set next to a large number.
Showing one UI piece large on its own.
